description: This Java class 'HashCrypt' provides utilities for various hashing operations, including SHA-1/PBKDF2 one-way hash encryption, password comparison, and hash digest generation. It supports multiple hash algorithms and encoding schemes used for cryptographic purposes within the project.

classes.name: HashCrypt
classes.description: Utility class for cryptographic hashing functions including SHA, PBKDF2, and encoding utilities.

methods.name: comparePassword
methods.description: Compares a hashed password with a plaintext password, supporting different encoding formats.

methods.name: doCompareTypePrefix
methods.description: Handles comparison when hash is prefixed with a specific type indicator.

methods.name: doComparePosix
methods.description: Handles comparison for POSIX-style hashed passwords.

methods.name: doCompareBare
methods.description: Handles comparison for bare hashed strings without type prefixes.

methods.name: cryptPassword
methods.description: Deprecated; generates crypt hash for a password with specified hash type and salt.

methods.name: cryptUTF8
methods.description: Generates crypt hash of a UTF-8 string with specified hash type and salt.

methods.name: cryptValue
methods.description: Encrypts a value with specified hash type and salt.

methods.name: cryptBytes
methods.description: Encodes byte array into a cryptographic hash string with hash type and salt.

methods.name: getCryptedBytes
methods.description: Computes the cryptographic digest bytes for input data.

methods.name: pbkdf2HashCrypt
methods.description: Creates a PBKDF2 hashed password string with specified hash type and salt.

methods.name: doComparePbkdf2
methods.description: Compares a PBKDF2 hashed password with a plaintext password.

methods.name: digestHash
methods.description: Creates a hash digest string for input string or bytes using specified hash type.

methods.name: digestHash64
methods.description: Creates a base64-encoded hash digest string.

methods.name: getHashTypeFromPrefix
methods.description: Deprecated; extracts hash type from prefixed hash string.

methods.name: removeHashTypePrefix
methods.description: Deprecated; removes hash type prefix from hash string.

methods.name: digestHashOldFunnyHex
methods.description: Creates a hash digest and encodes it in a special 'oldFunnyHex' format.

methods.name: oldFunnyHex
methods.description: Encodes digest bytes into a special hex string used historically in the project.
